svg.title: Illustrative asymptotic operation counts
svg.desc: A log-log plot compares constant, logarithmic, linear, n log n, and quadratic operation-count models as input size grows from ten to one million. An annotation notes that a quadratic all-pairs calculation has one trillion pair checks at one million inputs. The plot is an asymptotic work model, not a benchmark.
